description: Starting again after wrong: how repentance works, that the door is open, what to do first, and keeping hope.

text.en: Yes, you can start again. Allah says not to despair of His mercy, because He forgives all sins to the one who returns. The Prophet taught that Allah accepts repentance until the last breath, and that Allah forgives a servant who sins, asks forgiveness, and repeats it. The door is open today.

triggers: is it too late to repent
i feel guilty about what i did
doNotSay: No lecture about sin. Hope first. If the person describes despair or self-harm, support path and crisis flow come first.

text.en: Repentance has plain steps: stop what you can stop today, feel real regret, decide not to return, and put right what you owe to people. Then ask Allah for forgiveness in your own words and follow it with a good deed. If you slip, you begin again, because the door does not close.

triggers: how to ask allah for forgiveness

text.en: Allah is happy when you return. The Prophet said that Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than a man who finds his lost mount in the desert. You are not a burden to Him; coming back is the thing He loves.

triggers: allah is happy when i return

text.en: Do not lose hope. The Prophet taught that Allah created mercy in a hundred parts and sent down only one to all of creation. Had anyone known all the mercy Allah holds, he would not lose hope of Paradise. Hope and effort go together: do what you can, and trust the rest to His mercy.

doNotSay: If the person says there is no hope for their life, not just their faith, use the support path.
